scope: Private native v9 receive store for the actual admitted creating credential at epoch 1/generation 1. No editor, receive transport/service route, enrollment or personal activation.

compatibility_defect.finding: Passing each extension version into the shared startup verifier made a v7 reader refuse v8 at an earlier boundary with a different error. The two existing v8 activation assertions failed; no unsupported editor was returned.
compatibility_defect.repair: Retain the existing v8 ceiling for all older factories and allow v9 only for the explicit v9 extension. Only that storage-only extension may infer principal from the authenticated marker.
compatibility_defect.after: Both original activation regressions and the complete v8 campaign pass on final source.

cleanup_review: Successful verifier plaintext is captured inside the task callback before the task wrapper can reject a late continuation. This was a code-review improvement, not a separately reproduced production failure.
limits: Tests use actual admitted synthetic Accounts. Arbitrary test-only envelopes use a disposable credential; they do not establish safe credential cloning or enrollment of another real writer.
One creating stream only. General baseline/epoch/membership transitions, concurrency, revocation/finalization and coordinated restore remain open.
No remote editor promotion, automatic receive driver or v2 service route is enabled. The v9 fixture cannot be opened by its older editor factory.
Whole-ledger and content replay is deliberately unoptimized; retained-event growth and backlog performance remain open.
Native generated cuts and effective controls are bounded evidence, not a whole-protocol correctness proof. No additional design/implementation counterexample was found by these generators.
New native waits explicitly await bounded predicates. Existing v8 regression waits retain their historical implementation and are not credited as new polling conformance evidence.
Full pnpm check and whole debt payment are not claimed. Registered Node runners ran directly.
Personal release, predecessor dist, browser, factors and server state were not changed.
